# Overview

Last updated on 2024-06-05

## Resource: Group

View [Resource Fields and Examples](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/im-v1/chat/chat-info/intro).

### Methods

| | | Required scopes (Satisfy any) | | **[Access token](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uMTNz4yM1MjLzUzM) (Select any)** | Store | Custom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` /open-apis/im/v1/chats > Create a group and set the profile photo, name, and description for the group. | | tenant_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `GET` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id > Obtain basic information such as group name, description, profile photo, and owner ID. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `PUT` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id > Update the group profile photo, name, description, and configuration, or assign new group owner. | | tenant_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `DELETE` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id > The bot recalls messages it sent or the group owner recalls messages within a group. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `GET` /open-apis/im/v1/chats > Updates the content of message cards sent by an app. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `GET` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/search > Delays the update of message cards after interaction with users. | | tenant_access_token user _access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |

### Event list

| | **[Event](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uUTNz4SN1MjL1UzM)** | Trigger time | Required scopes (Satisfy any) | Event type | Store | Custom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Group deletion](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/im-v1/chat/events/disbanded) | This event is triggered when a group is deleted. | [View group information](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uQjN3QjL0YzN04CN2cDN) | im.chat.disbanded_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |
| [Modify group configurations](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/reference/im-v1/chat/events/updated) | This event is triggered when the group configurations are modified, including assignment of new group owner and modification of basic group information and permission scopes. | [View group information](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uQjN3QjL0YzN04CN2cDN) | im.chat.updated_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |

## Resource: Group - group member

View [Resource Fields and Examples](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/im-v1/chat/chat-member/intro).

### Methods

| | | Required scopes (Satisfy any) | | **[Access token](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uMTNz4yM1MjLzUzM) (Select any)** | Store | Custom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/members > Adds a user or bot to a group chat. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `DELETE` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/members > Removes a user or bot from a group chat. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `PATCH` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/members/me_join > Replies to a specific message, with text, rich text, cards, group cards, name cards, images, videos, audios, files, and emojis supported. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `GET` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/members > The bot recalls messages it sent or the group owner recalls messages within a group. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `GET` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/members/is_in_chat > Queries the read status of a message. | | tenant_access_token usert_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |

### Event list

| | | Trigger time | Required scopes (Satisfy any) | Event type | Store | Custom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | This event is triggered when a bot is added to a group chat. | | im.chat.member.bot.added_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |
| | This event is triggered when a bot is removed from a group chat. | | im.chat.member.bot.deleted_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |
| | This event is triggered when a new user joins a group chat. | | im.chat.member.user.added_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |
| | The event is pushed when users leaves a group voluntarily or are removed from a group chat. | | im.chat.member.user.deleted_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |
| | This event is triggered when the invitation of a user to a group is revoked. | | im.chat.member.user.withdrawn_v1 | **✓** | **✓** | |

## Resource: Group - group announcement

View [Resource fields and examples](https://open.larksuite.com/document/uAjLw4CM/ukTMukTMukTM/im-v1/chat/chat-announcement/intro).

### Methods

| | | Required scopes (Satisfy any) | | **[Access token](https://open.larksuite.com/document/ukTMukTMukTM/uMTNz4yM1MjLzUzM) (Select any)** | Store | Custom |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/announcement > Obtain group announcement information in a chat, with the same format as Docs. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
| `PATCH` /open-apis/im/v1/chats/:chat_id/announcement > Update group announcement information in a chat, with the same format as Docs. | | tenant_access_token user_access_token | **✓** | **✓** | | |
